# Attach to minapp

The lab is up (see [Setting up the lab](../first_steps/setting_up_the_lab.qmd)):
emulator booted, frida-server running, minapp installed.

## 1. Launch the app

```bash
$ adb shell am start -n re.frida.minapp/.MainActivity
$ adb shell 'ps -A | grep minapp'
u0_a141  2812  325  13649704 128276 do_epoll_wait 0 S re.frida.minapp
```

The pid is 2812 on this run. It changes on every launch, read it fresh.

## 2. Attach by name

The process name is the app *label*, `FridaMin`:

```text
[0x00000000]> fridaoj frida://attach/usb//FridaMin
{"ok":true,"result":{"action":"attach","pid":2812,"resumed":false,"state":"attached"}}
```

The reply reports the resolved `pid`, whether the target was `resumed`, and
the session `state`.

> **Note:** attaching by the package name fails: frida knows the process by
> its label. `frida-ps -U` shows the names to use.

```text
[0x00000000]> fridaoj frida://attach/usb//re.frida.minapp
{"ok":false,"error":{"code":"invalid_target","message":"Process not found"}}
```

## 3. Attach by pid

```text
[0x00000000]> fridacj
{"ok":true,"result":{"pid":2812,"state":"closed"}}

[0x00000000]> fridaoj frida://attach/usb//2812
{"ok":true,"result":{"action":"attach","pid":2812,"resumed":false,"state":"attached"}}
```

## 4. Check the Java VM

```text
[0x00000000]> fridaJj
{"ok":true,"result":{"available":true}}
```

`fridaJj` checks whether the Android Java VM (ART) is reachable from the
agent. `available:true` means the Java commands will work.

![Attached to minapp](img/android_journey/attach-minapp.png)

## 5. Session state

```text
[0x00000000]> fridasj
{"ok":true,"result":{"active":true,"state":"attached","pid":2812,"action":"attach","target":"FridaMin"}}
```

Close the session when done:

```text
[0x00000000]> fridacj
{"ok":true,"result":{"pid":2812,"state":"closed"}}
```

The app keeps running: attach never kills its target.

::: {.callout-tip}
### Try

Attach, ping the agent (`fridaij`), check the Java VM, read the session
state, close. Repeat with a fresh pid.
:::
